literal_meaning: আহাম্মকের গলায় দড়ি (a rope around the neck of a fool)
figurative_meaning_bn: আহাম্মক বারবার দোষ করে ও শাস্তি পায়
figurative_meaning_en: A fool repeatedly commits mistakes and receives punishment
similar_in_english: Give a fool enough rope and he'll hang himself
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আহাম্মকের গলায় দড়ির মতো বারবার একই ভুল করে ফেলে।
এই কাজটা করতে গিয়ে আবারও আহাম্মকের গলায় দড়ির মতো শাস্তি পেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He keeps making the same mistake, just like a fool with a rope around his neck.
By repeating his errors, he ended up getting punished again, like a fool with a noose.
note: This idiom draws from rural imagery of restraint or inevitable consequence, common in Bengali oral traditions.
